text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's four in the morning, the very crack of
dawn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wide awake, I head outside to take a
walk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I stroll about, I hear a commotion in
the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head toward the source of the noise,
where I
find Director Akikawa and
several other staff
members.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Commendations! Wonderful work,
everyone!
Another day, another pristine
track!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! In recognition of your efforts...
Behold! I
have decided to bestow upon
you all a new piece
of equipment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrrroom, vroom, vrrroooom!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Erm... Director? What on earth is that
strange
machine?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Surprised? 'Tis a turf and dirt course
maintenance
machine... or so I'm reliably
informed! It's a
cutting-edge model ten
times more efficient than
our current
methods!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Between its prodigious size and high

performance, it's the invention of the
century!
Thusly! I was happy to empty
my own pockets to
obtain it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt! Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Why's it making that weird noise?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured! I'm confident that you can
master it
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
But it's only natural to fear the
unknown... Very
well! Allow me to
provide a demonstration!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But Director, you can't ride that!
It's five
times your size!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense! I was born on the turf! Raised
by it! I
am one with the maintenance
equipment!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now let's see here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zzzoooom!!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Director?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Apologies... Phew... Thank you all.
Without your
intervention, I dread to
think what might have
happened!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
A-as long as you're all right... But what
compelled
you to buy this?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally... it is to express my gratitude
to you all!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to your hard work that our
students
can focus on pursuing their
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Tireless commitment! Flawless
performance! As
much as it is within my
power, I want to reward
you for your
efforts!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Director...

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Director. You won't regret
placing
your trust in us. We'll put this
machine to good
use!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now that's the kind of smile I like to see!

Wonderful! Magnificent! I'll be counting
on you
all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the staff members seem heartened
by Director
Akikawa's commitment to
the academy and its
students.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling inspired by her enthusiasm
myself, I
resolve to help her out in any
way I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, I tell <chrname> what I
saw.
